description:
Brand Introduction

Born and established in London, skinnovationLab® is a pioneering British beauty tech brand dedicated to bringing professional-grade skincare treatments into the home. Our award-winning collection of beauty devices, featuring advanced in-house technology, is clinically proven to tone, firm, and reduce wrinkles, enabling users to achieve their best skin yet.

Product Description

skinnovationLab® offers an exclusive range of high-performance skincare devices, including:

  • Crystal Ultra 336 MX‑LED: Professional-grade LED skincare.

  • Muse 3D RF 430C: Advanced 3D Multi-Polar Radio Frequency Technology.

  • Devices specifically designed for anti-ageing, acne treatment, brightening, hydration, redness relief, collagen enhancement, and texture improvement.

All products are clinically tested, backed by 2-year warranties, 30-day money-back guarantees, free shipping within the UK, Europe, and the Middle East, alongside 24/7 customer support.

Unique Selling Point (USP)

  • Clinically-backed innovation: Immediate visible results and sustained skin health.

  • Home spa experience: Award-winning design for salon-quality skincare at home.

  • Premium customer service: Comprehensive support with warranties, returns, and expert advice.

Payment Terms

Affiliates earn commissions based on the order value:

  • £0 - £99: 0% commission

  • £100 - £249: 5% commission

  • £250 - £499: 10% commission

  • £500 and above: 12% commission

Cookie duration: 30 days
Payout schedule: Monthly payouts via PayPal or Bank Transfer once the minimum threshold is reached.

Other Information

  • Affiliates have access to high-quality promotional materials (banners, images, text links).

  • Regular campaign updates, exclusive affiliate offers, and dedicated affiliate support.

  • Ideal for influencers and marketers targeting beauty enthusiasts, technology-focused consumers, and luxury skincare audiences.

  • Attractive introductory offers available for first-time buyers across the UK, Europe, and the Middle East.
